title: HiveTalk
summary: A repository with no README providing context, containing a Python backend whose only match to the SDV family is an unrelated coincidental filename fragment in a pinned dependency path. The requirements.txt line referencing 'sdv' is part of a local conda build path for more-itertools, not an actual SDV dependency.
evidence: backend/requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/...' — 'sdv' appears only inside a random build hash string
needs: No genuine SDV usage found; the match is a false positive from a random temp directory name.
